general.languageDescription: İmece's interface language. Turkish is the default; English remains available as a fallback.

configError.title: İmece is using the last valid settings — config.toml has a problem
configError.resetSuccess: config.toml reset to defaults (previous file backed up alongside it)

enterToSend.label: Enter to send
enterToSend.description: Enter sends your message; Shift+Enter inserts a newline — the Slack/Discord/ChatGPT convention. Turn off to restore the old behavior, where only ⌘/Ctrl+Enter sends and Enter always inserts a newline. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter always sends either way.

terminalNotifications.sectionSubtitle: Be told when a command finishes or wants input, wherever you are in İmece
terminalNotifications.label: Terminal notifications
terminalNotifications.description: A command that fails, runs longer than the threshold, or asks for input raises an item in the notification center, a toast when its terminal is off screen, and a notification when İmece is in the background. Nothing fires while you are looking at that terminal.

notifySuccessAfter.label: Notify on success after
notifySuccessAfter.description: A command that succeeds faster than this stays quiet. Failures always notify (below).

notifyOnFailure.label: Notify on failure
notifyOnFailure.description: A non-zero exit code notifies regardless of how long the command ran. Ctrl-C is not a failure.

notifyOnAttention.label: Notify when input is needed
notifyOnAttention.description: A password prompt, a terminal bell, or a program's own notification (OSC 9 / 777) while the terminal is not on screen.

native.label: macOS notifications
native.description: Also raise a system notification when the İmece window is not focused.

sound.label: Sound
sound.description: Play a short chime with terminal notifications.

autoGitignore.label: Auto-add .atlas to .gitignore
autoGitignore.description: When you open a git-tracked project, İmece adds `.atlas/` to the project's .gitignore (creating one if needed). İmece keeps its caches and state in `.atlas/` — keeping it out of version control is almost always what you want. No-op on non-git projects.

showHiddenFiles.label: Show hidden files
showHiddenFiles.description: Show dotfiles and dot-directories (e.g. `.git`, `.atlas`, `.env`) in the file tree. Default ON so nothing is silently hidden. Turn off for a cleaner tree that only shows your project's visible files.

gitBlameInline.label: Inline Git blame
gitBlameInline.description: Show who last changed the current line, when, and the commit summary as a dim annotation at the end of the line — following your cursor. Only for files inside a git repository.

enableLogs.label: Enable İmece Logs
enableLogs.description: Record İmece-internal events (sign-in, agent start/finish, browser/file open, etc.) into the Logs tab under the `atlas` source. Default ON so when something goes wrong you can open the Logs tab, filter by `atlas`, and share a timeline. Turn off if the noise bothers you.

shareTelemetry.label: Share usage data
shareTelemetry.description: Telemetry is disabled in İmece — this toggle has no effect. No usage data leaves your device.

linkTelemetryToAccount.label: Link usage data to my account
linkTelemetryToAccount.description: While signed in, attribute usage data to your İmece account instead of an anonymous per-device id. Turn this off to stay anonymous even when signed in — already-linked history stays linked.

sendFeedback.label: Send feedback
sendFeedback.description: Report a bug, request a feature, or tell us what feels clumsy — with an optional screenshot. Opens a panel in the bottom-right corner.

adaptiveSuggestions.label: Next-step suggestions
adaptiveSuggestions.description: After each turn, the coding agent suggests 2-3 follow-up actions as clickable chips (click = send). It uses the agent's own live session context — no extra API key — and the request/suggestions are hidden from the thread.

cli.label: İmece CLI
cli.description: Adds an `atlas` command to your shell — type `atlas .` in any terminal to open the current folder as a project. Refreshed automatically on every launch so an older copy never lingers. {{status}}.

modelPricing.label: Model pricing
modelPricing.description: Per-model prices (USD / 1M tokens) from models.dev, shown in the model picker. Refreshed automatically on launch and updated only when prices change. {{status}}

updates.sectionSubtitle: How İmece keeps itself up to date

autoUpdate.label: Automatic updates
autoUpdate.description: Check for a newer version in the background and download it automatically. İmece verifies the update before installing. Turn off to never check or download.

checkForUpdates.label: Check for updates
checkForUpdates.description: Check now regardless of the automatic-update setting. Newer versions download in the background; you'll be prompted to restart when ready.
checkForUpdates.descriptionReady: A new version has been downloaded and verified. Restart now, or it'll be applied automatically the next time you quit İmece.

about.description: Atlas fork — telemetry-free, Linux-supported, customized for personal use. Built with Tauri, React, and Rust.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.description: Rearrange panels and tabs into a ready-made workspace. Press <kbd>{{hint}}</kbd> anytime to switch layouts.
